create_BasicEncoder: create a BasicEncoder feature extractor with configurable output dimension and batch normalization for optical flow
create_SmallEncoder: create a SmallEncoder lightweight feature extractor using BottleneckBlock layers for RAFT optical flow
create_ResidualBlock: create a ResidualBlock convolutional layer with configurable normalization and stride for feature extraction
create_BottleneckBlock: create a BottleneckBlock with 1x1-3x3-1x1 conv pattern and configurable normalization for efficient feature extraction
test_BasicEncoder_forward: test the BasicEncoder forward pass with a batch of RGB image tensors
